latest.title: After SpaceX restores high-speed service, Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink agreement
latest.description: Ukraine says restrictions on Starlink and Starshield have been lifted, restoring connectivity to fast-moving military systems after disruptions.

latest.title: Democrats, voting-rights groups challenge Trump's bid to block Alaska Senate certification
latest.description: Lawsuits filed by candidate Mary Peltola and a voters' rights group challenge Trump's preemptive efforts to block a Democratic Senate victory in Alaska.

latest.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
latest.description: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

latest.title: AI funding fears rattle Wall Street. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio
latest.description: The rotation out of AI stocks benefited several defensive Club stocks.

latest.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
latest.description: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.

latest.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
latest.description: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

latest.title: Fewer people are flying as airfare soars. Here's why airlines aren't worried
latest.description: Airlines are reporting fewer people flew in the third quarter as airfare surged on fuel costs, but executives say travelers are mostly swallowing higher fares.

latest.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
latest.description: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

latest.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
latest.description: Airplanes are getting dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and other components are in short supply.

latest.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
latest.description: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

latest.title: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
latest.description: Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, told Decrypt that Activision suggested cutting discs nearly two decades ago.

latest.title: Retail investors are not more sophisticated than 30 years ago, says former hedge fund manager
latest.description: Retail investors trying to beat the market by buying individual stocks and complex exchange-traded funds may be better off with broad market index funds.

latest.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
latest.description: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.

latest.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
latest.description: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

latest.title: I quit my marketing job to walk dogs for 4 months: It's 'one of the most valuable professional experiences I've ever had'
latest.description: "People sometimes assume dog walking was a gap or detour in my career. I see it as one of the most valuable professional experiences I've had," says Sally Simmons.

latest.title: Amgen says drug combo cuts risk of death by 58% in patients with aggressive lung cancer
latest.description: A drug from Amgen could give patients with an aggressive form of lung cancer significantly more time to live when added to an immunotherapy from AstraZeneca.

latest.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
latest.description: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

latest.title: An ex-bookkeeper spent $375 to launch a sewing business: 'I hadn't felt so sure about something like that in a long time'
latest.description: Eric Lugo runs Stitch Lab ATX, a sewing studio that offers group classes and events to teach basic sewing skills.

latest.title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
latest.description: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.
